purpose: Operational PAPER validation only. Probe eligibility uses high pre-calibration data confidence so execution samples can be created without weakening calibrated investment decisions. This cannot authorize broker connectivity, live order transmission or movement of real capital.
approvalReference: Operator instruction on 2026-09-24 to continue Fenice. V4 corrects a circular validation dependency found after the first clean v3 evidence day: immature calibration conservatively reduced committee confidence below the probe threshold, while probe fills were themselves required to mature execution/calibration evidence.
notes: V4 does not lower the approved 90 confidence floor. It applies that floor to the pre-calibration data-confidence evidence used only for operational PAPER probe eligibility. The Investment Committee decision remains based on post-calibration confidence and therefore keeps the conservative penalty while evidence is immature. Every probe must still pass committee score >=70, risk <=75, permitted decision/currency, market-data quorum, decision-data gate, portfolio risk, pre-trade risk, kill switch, audit and reconciliation. Probe size remains EUR 250-300 equivalent with at most 3% of EUR capital and 15% single-asset ceiling; maximum one probe per UTC day and twenty total attempts for ten target fills. LIVE and broker connectivity remain forbidden.
